Despite his efforts, John is deemed talentless by the Francisco's family and is brutally cast out; left with nothing but memories of his stolen inheritance from his father and the pain of rejection. John contemplates ending his suffering but ultimately resolves to survive by wandering the unforgiving streets of Golden City.
Living hand-to-mouth, John clings to the little cash he had managed to save before his parents' untimely demise. With grit and relentless determination, he becomes a street vendor, working day and night. It's now two years and John has amassed $5,000, gaining local fame as “Jonte,” the resilient vendor whose story continues to inspire many.
Fearing the resentment of the Francisco's family in the city, John decision to relocate and move to Greenland City in the eastern was no doubt. Thereafter, capitalizing $4000 on his first investment, who knew that John would receive a prompt with a congratulatory message that echoed in his mind with an irritating mechanical voice!
[Congratulations for activating Ten Times Investment Rebate System.…
the-academys-shut-in-young-master:
Silas Rooke dies in every route of Crownless Requiem.
After an exhausting life spent answering to toxic bosses, the man who wakes in his body wants a better ending. A comfortable home, money to spare, and the freedom to spend his days however he likes would be a good start.
Unfortunately, he’s inherited a hated young master’s enemies along with his name—and arrived a week before the game’s story begins, in a body that has already died.
That wasn’t supposed to happen.
With his knowledge suddenly less reliable than he’d hoped, Silas finds an unexpected advantage in a Talent that never existed in the game.
[The Shut-In Young Master — SSS / Singularity]
Anyone who enters his room brings a Soul Talent he can copy and, with enough practice, make his own.
At an academy filled with dangerous prodigies and powerful heirs, even an unwelcome visitor might be an opportunity.
But someone has already killed the original Silas, and the deaths he remembers are still waiting. Locking the door and hoping for the best would only mean waiting for his turn.
If he wants a peaceful life, he’ll have to survive his enemies, gather their powers, and make sure nobody gets to decide his ending again.
the-bastard-first-prince-doesnt-want-to-:
The heir of a border lord sacrificed his life in battle, hoping to repay the lord’s kindness, but his efforts were in vain.
However, when he opened his eyes again…
“I’m… the First Prince?”
He had taken over the body of the notorious first prince.
The only problem… this guy was going to die soon.
the-citys-strongest-son-in-law:
Everyone regards Su Changfeng as a worthless son-in-law. Enduring humiliation in a wealthy family, yet he always remains silent endures.
But who could have imagined, beneath the seemingly worthless son-in-law, how powerful his existence truly is?
Mastering strategies and stirring up the storm, everything I do is for one person.
the-immortals-gourmet-record:
Ever since the Master established the world's rites with the seventy-two earliest priestly dishes.
The Daoist Ancestor rode an ox and passed down the 'Virtue Dao Scripture', leaving behind only two legendary ingredients, from which the infinite Great Dao emerged.
In later generations, countless Saints and Sages, scholars and poets, heroes and villains, Immortals and Demon Fiends, left behind one after another popular dish and ingredient, giving rise to venerable Immortal Spirits born from them, known as... 'Jade Food Immortals'!
Ordinary people all say: To be favored by a Jade Food Immortal means that even Immortals, Buddhas, Demon Fiends, monsters, and ghosts cannot harm you, truly a person of great Destiny.
Between the Jiu Province, clashes are constant. In the Outer Realm, ferocious and Barbaric forces lie in wait. Who can establish order in the world? Only the one who masters the Dao and the Priest's art, the Food Immortal!
....
Looking at the numerous non-human beings, the wild and Barbaric strange species.
Zhao Tiansheng clapped his hands.
“Everyone, do you want to be my diners, or do you want to be my ingredients?”
the-rise-of-millwal:
“No one likes us, it doesn't matter!”
“It doesn't matter if everyone likes us!”
Aldridge, possessed by time and space, never imagined that one day he would become the boss of the notorious Millwall in England.
The Edwards family gave Ferguson seven years to finally recreate the dynasty of the Busby Boys.
After Graham's glory, the arsenal was looking for the next Chapman. The professor who was fired for the first time left for Japan, always waiting for the call from Europe.
Liverpool, which has won the Champions League four times in seven years, still lives in the shadow of Manchester United.
White Hart Lane is gradually becoming ordinary, Stamford Bridge is dimly blue, Jin Yuan's violent Ben challenges the throne, Keegan trains the gorgeous magpie to soar to the sky!
In the summer of 1994, the Millwall Youth Army, led by young coach Aldridge, was about to rewrite the history of a hundred years without a championship.
That dark blue of a mad lion is determined to sweep Europe...
the-rising-phoenix:
Opening her eyes, she becomes the eldest daughter of the Great General of Liuyin Kingdom.
She is the modern girl that transmigrated into a world that only respects the strong.
Bullied by her cousins...
Broken engagement...
She did not care about all of that.
Her motto is inspired by one of her favourite anime, Hyouka: “If I don't have to do it, I won't. If I have to do it, I'll make it quick.”
“You already come into this Lord's hug. Don't you dare to run?” A Lord threatens her.
“Do you think I'm scared of you? You can keep dreaming.” She spoke back.
She just wants to have a peaceful life, however, can she has it?
the-villainess-redeems-herself-the-beast:
Selene traveled to the Interstellar world and was bound with a Good Pregnancy System.
In this Empire where males are many and females are few, females have obtained indisputable privileges.
But precisely because the original owner could not get love, she crazily tortured several Beast Husbands around her.
She looked at the Persian cat first husband who hated her to the extreme for breaking his leg,
the gloomy butterfly second husband who could never paint again after she broke his fingers,
and the twin black snake Beast Husbands with countless schemes,
she was left in the dark, does this mean she has to enforce hatred?
System: If you have one child, you can bring a new technology to your original world.
Selene: Birth, isn't it just giving birth to a child? I can do it!
As long as she can use advanced interstellar technology to save more people, she has the strength and means to handle these rebellious Beast Husbands.
Give me a soldier, and I will return you a platoon.
However, she only treated having children as a task, why did the proud Beast Husbands all come to her seeking affection?
She runs he chases, he finds it difficult to escape.
True Fragrance Alert !!

unmei-pantheons-game:
You have no memories. You don’t know who you are or why you’re here. But none of that matters.
You are one of a thousand chosen, thrown into the Pantheon’s Ordeal, a brutal trial created by the gods. The rules are simple: survive, grow stronger, and uncover the truth about yourself. But this trial is not fair. The challenges will break you. The monsters will hunt you. And the people beside you? They are not your allies, they are your competition.
Only ten will make it to the end. The rest will be lost forever. But if you survive, the gods will reward you with power beyond imagination.
Now, fight. Endure. Remember who you are.
Dune wakes up in a strange, empty place with no memory of who he is or how he got there. All he knows is that he needs to survive.
As he faces dangerous creatures, humans, and tough trials, Dune starts to uncover fragments of his past. He meets allies and enemies, each revealing new clues about the mysterious world around him.
Driven by a need to remember, Dune pushes through impossible, hoping to reclaim his identity and uncover the truth about world he’s trapped in.
xianxia-i-can-download-fully-levelled-ab:

While everyone else worked hard to cultivate, all he needed was to press a button to download it! Be it superior cultivating manuals, superior physiques, spiritual treasures, or elixirs, all Lin Yi needed to do was press download and they would be his.
